items: NEW ADMISSIONS: 2 Twins Mizan and Miran Zubin Engineer — Std. I from Pune.
SSC: 1 student Sarosh K. Bharucha (LD) scored 93.00%.
Navar: Maidhyarem K. Chinoy at Rustomframna Agyari, Dadar (12 May).
Maratab: Berjis K. Bharda at Udwada (7 May).
2 students left: Er. Sarosh Khushru Bharucha finished SSC; Rushad B. Katpitia stayed for a year and left for medical reasons after Std. V without Navar-Maratab.
Total Strength: Same as last year: 14 — 13 school + 1 college (Shyamak Sanjana, TYBAF).
Er. Zhian M. Turel Std. IX selected Head Boy of the school (Jul) and Mr. DPYA.
Er. Shahan Bhesadia (Std. IX) certified with Learning Disability in March. Maidyarem Chinoy (IX) and Ziyan Nalladaru (VIII) have applied for it in November.
Internal Bhantar exams in April and November. New Weekly classes for Spoken English by Speech trainer Mrs. Nergesh A. Dodhy.

Visitors: Dastur Mehraban Poladi from Yazd and Prof. Dr. Salomi from Cambridge University (18 Dec 24); Return to Roots programme (~30 youths, Mar 20); Asiatic Society field trip — The Geography of Belief (24 Aug); Public launch of Film Mobeds at MGMA.
In April and May the entire Institute was painted from inside courtesy a donor. November onwards, another donor sponsored the complete roof work.

Outings: Iran league Prize Distribution (Apr 12); Zoroastrian Saga Programme (Apr 11,13); Picnic to Pawana lake and Tikona fort (Feb); Movies Chhava, Jaat, Mufasa; Kidzania, Musso, play Lage raho Bomanji on Khordad Sal; outdoor walk and a treat for students at Dadar's McDonalds (30 Aug).
All Navar students attended Nirang-din ritual at Banaji Limji Agyari (18 Jan). Participated in Narielwala fire temple Salgreh Jashan (Apr 14).
Empowering Mobeds: Field trip to M.F. Cama Athornan Institute (25 Jan); field trip to Alpaiwala Museum, Khareghat Colony, followed by snacks.
Gifts: canteen oven, Aquaguard water filter, formal clothes, toys, football uniform, T-shirts and track pants from donors.
Sports — DPYA School (Jan): Maidyarem K. Chinoy multiple prizes; Shahan Bhesadia Relay I; Huzan Z. Engineer Shot Put I.
All Parsi Sports (Feb 8-9): Maidyarem Chinoy won boys under 14 Championship; Shahan Bhesadia and Zhian Turel won multiple prizes.
Competitions: Iran League Religious Quiz, Western Vocal, Gujarati Reading, Monajat, Shahnameh, Bhantar (BPA), English Elocution — multiple prize winners among Institute students.
